provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2025-26 UEFA Champions League semifinals and final as played: the semifinal first legs on 28 and 29 April (Paris Saint-Germain beat Bayern Munich 5-4, Atlético Madrid drew 1-1 with Arsenal), the second legs on 5 and 6 May (Arsenal beat Atlético 1-0, Bayern drew 1-1 with Paris), and the final at the Puskás Aréna, Budapest, on 30 May (Paris Saint-Germain drew 1-1 with Arsenal after extra time and won the shoot-out). The semifinals are one event of two games, game 1 the first legs and game 2 the second legs; the final is one game. The field is every outfield player in either side's matchday squad for the round (goalkeepers left out), with UEFA's position (defender, midfielder or forward) and nationality; a player who came on or started has a line, an unused substitute none. Each line's goals, assists and shots on target (UEFA's attempts on target) are UEFA's own match statistics, cross-checked against ESPN's box scores, which agree on every line but three, where UEFA's record is kept: Joshua Kimmich's shots on target in the first leg in Paris (UEFA 0, ESPN 1), Julián Alvarez's in the first leg in Madrid (UEFA 3, ESPN 2), and Leandro Trossard's assist, which UEFA gives for Bukayo Saka's goal in the second leg in London and ESPN for Kai Havertz's goal in the final. Shoot-out kicks count for nothing. Ranking is the player's Hat Trick total in the 2025-26 competition before the round (3 per goal + 2 per assist + shots on target), from UEFA's competition statistics less the round's matches (for the semifinals, less the final too); ties go by name.
